{{Top|leg}}
'''Stalker missiles''' were complex [[Missile/Legends|ordinance]] designed specifically for use with the [[RAX-1]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]]. The Stalker missile was similar to the [[smart missile]], with an inbuilt tracking system. The system was well-designed and could attempt to reacquire its target if the lock was lost during its flight.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
